00051 class BEQBaseUGenInternal : public UGenInternal
00052 {
00053 public:
00054     BEQBaseUGenInternal(UGen const& input, UGen const& freq, UGen const& control, UGen const& gain, const bool faster) throw();
00055     void processBlock(bool& shouldDelete, const unsigned int blockID, const int channel) throw();
00056     
00057     enum Inputs { Input, Freq, Control, Gain, NumInputs }; // subclass should define their own interpretation of "Control" whether rQ, rS or bw
00058     
00059     virtual void calculateCoeffs(const float freq, const float control, const float gain, 
00060                                  double& a0, double& a1, double& a2, double& b1, double& b2) = 0;
00061     
00062     inline void calculateCoeffs(const float freq, const float control, const float gain = 1.f)
00063     {
00064         calculateCoeffs(currentFreq     = freq, 
00065                         currentControl  = control, 
00066                         currentGain     = gain, 
00067                         a0, a1, a2, b1, b2);
00068     }
00069     
00070     void initValue(const float value) throw();
00071     
00072 private:
00073     double y1, y2, a0, a1, a2, b1, b2;
00074     float currentFreq, currentControl, currentGain;
00075 //  bool initialised;
00076     
00077 protected:
00078     const bool faster_;
00079 };
